metadata.title: Oracle Reports Higher Profit on Surging Cloud Revenue - WSJ

content.text:
Oracle ORCL -2.21%decrease; down pointing triangle reported higher profit as surging revenue from it cloud infrastructure business more than offset a decline in its software during the fourth quarter.
The cloud-computing and software company on Wednesday reported a 47% increase in its cloud revenue, to $9.9 billion, which includes a 93% increase in cloud-infrastructure revenue. Growth in the company’s Oracle Cloud Infrastructure business reflects continuing strong demand for artificial-intelligence computing workloads, co-Chief Executive Officer Clay Magouyrk said on an analyst call.
